explication: This repository is primarily a curated directory of Claude Code plugins: users browse capability categories, choose a plugin, then use it in Claude Code. The README documents an install-and-setup path for the Composio integration and broad plugin categories. The tree also contains runtime code for audit-project, perf, ship, security-guidance, and skill-bus; excerpts are limited, so their internal wiring is not inferred beyond the sampled pipeline and entry-point exports.
